question: In the health planning cycle, Phase 6 (monitoring and evaluation) can only begin after all five preceding phases have been fully completed and the programme has been running for at least one year.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Correct — the statement is FALSE. Monitoring and evaluation is an ongoing, concurrent activity. It begins from the time activities start and provides continuous feedback that can trigger revision of earlier phases without waiting for programme completion.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Actually, this statement is FALSE. Monitoring is a concurrent, ongoing process that begins from programme launch — not after all phases are complete. The planning cycle is not strictly linear; M&E runs alongside implementation to provide real-time feedback for mid-course correction.
